jobDescription:
Job Description:

Designation / Title

Data Scientist II

Experience (Years)

3- 6 Yrs

Joining Location

Pune

About Quick Heal

Quick Heal Technologies Ltd, founded in 1995 and headquartered in Pune, is India’s leading listed cybersecurity solutions provider with 23 offices and 1,000+ professionals. Through its enterprise arm Seqrite, the company delivers cutting-edge Zero Trust solutions to secure endpoints, data, networks, and users across industries and geographies.

Seqrite Labs powers its offerings with advanced threat research, intelligence, and real-time detection. Notably, Seqrite secured ISRO’s command & control center during the Chandrayaan 3 mission. Its services division provides consulting to corporates, PSUs, government, and law enforcement agencies worldwide.

Core Purpose: Innovate to simplify digital security
Vision: To be trusted globally as a cybersecurity leader
Mission: Empower teams to solve business problems

Seqrite stands out as a purpose-led organization that invests in people, fosters innovation, and offers opportunities to work on new technologies while building a safer digital world.

Job Summary

(A brief overview of the role, its purpose, and key responsibilities.)

The Data Scientist will be responsible for analyzing data, building machine learning models, and generating insights to support cybersecurity and product use cases. The role involves data preprocessing, feature engineering, model development, model evaluation, and working with engineering teams to integrate ML outputs into applications, dashboards, or workflows.

The candidate should have hands-on experience in Python, SQL, machine learning techniques, data analysis, and basic MLOps concepts. Experience in cybersecurity analytics, anomaly detection, user behavior analytics, or AI/ML-based product development will be an added advantage.

Job Responsibilities

(The key tasks and duties you will be expected to perform in this role.)

· Understand business and product requirements and convert them into data analysis or machine learning tasks.

· Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured datasets from different sources.

· Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and useful insights.

· Build and validate machine learning models for classification, prediction, clustering, anomaly detection, and risk scoring use cases.

· Perform feature engineering to improve model accuracy and business relevance.

· Evaluate model performance using suitable metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and false positive rate.

· Work with engineering teams to integrate ML models or analytical outputs into products, APIs, reports, or dashboards.

· Support model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and performance tracking using basic MLOps practices.

· Prepare reports, visualizations, and documentation to communicate findings and model outcomes.

· Collaborate with product, engineering, security, and data teams to deliver practical data-driven solutions.

· Maintain proper documentation for datasets, model logic, assumptions, evaluation results, and limitations.

· Continuously learn and apply relevant AI/ML techniques, tools, and frameworks based on project needs.

· Strong communication, troubleshooting, co-ordination and interpersonal skill

Must Have Skills
(The essential skills and expertise required to succeed in this role.)

· Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent.

· 3–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI/ML solution development.

· Strong programming skills in Python.

· Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured/unstructured datasets.

· Hands-on experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model evaluation.

· Good understanding of ML algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and predictive modeling.

· Experience with Python libraries such as Pandas, Num Py, Scikit-learn, and visualization libraries.

· Basic understanding of MLOps, including model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and versioning.

· Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and present insights clearly.

· Good communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice / Good to have skills

(Additional skills that are not mandatory but give you an added advantage in this role.)

· Exposure to cybersecurity

· Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, or Agentic AI concepts.

· Experience with dashboards or visualization tools such as Power BI, Kibana, or Grafana

title: Senior Principal Product Manager - Enterprise
location: Solitaire BH 7th Floor, Pune, Maharashtra , India
jobDescription:
Senior Principal Product Manager – Enterprise Products

Company: Quick Heal Technologies Ltd. Location: Pune, India (On-site) Function: Product Management Experience: 10+ years

About Quick Heal & Seqrite

Quick Heal Technologies is one of India's leading cybersecurity solutions providers, protecting millions of consumers and businesses across the globe. Seqrite is the enterprise cybersecurity division of Quick Heal Technologies, delivering AI-driven security solutions for enterprises and government organizations. Its integrated portfolio includes Endpoint Protection (EPP), EDR/XDR, MDR, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Email Security, Vulnerability Management, Data Privacy, and Managed Security Services (MSS). Backed by Seqrite Labs' global threat intelligence, the company secures hybrid IT environments for more than 30,000 organizations across 76+ countries.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Principal Product Manager to lead our EDR & XDR product portfolio along with AI Security. This is a high-impact role for an experienced product leader who can define product strategy, own the roadmap end-to-end, and deliver innovative cybersecurity solutions that address evolving enterprise threats.

You will work at the intersection of enterprise cybersecurity, AI-driven innovation, and customer needs—shaping next-generation detection, investigation, and response capabilities for modern SOC teams. Partnering closely with engineering, threat research, AI/ML, design, sales, customer success, and executive leadership, you will translate market trends and threat intelligence into differentiated products that strengthen enterprise security, accelerate customer adoption, and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities

· Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the EDR, XDR, and AI Security portfolio, aligning product investments with customer needs, evolving threat landscapes, and business objectives.

· Define and execute the product strategy for next-generation detection, investigation, response, and AI-powered security capabilities to strengthen the enterprise cybersecurity platform.

· Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle—from customer discovery and market research to requirements, development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

· Collaborate closely with engineering, threat research, AI/ML, design, security operations, sales, marketing, and customer success teams to deliver high-quality, scalable security products.

· Translate customer challenges, threat intelligence, competitive insights, and emerging security trends into differentiated product capabilities and roadmap priorities.

· Drive AI-powered innovation across the portfolio, including intelligent detection, automated investigation, security copilots, threat hunting, and agentic security workflows, while ensuring responsible and secure AI adoption.

· Define product requirements, prioritize features using customer and business impact, and ensure timely execution while balancing technical debt, platform scalability, and innovation.

· Establish product success metrics, monitor adoption, detection efficacy, operational performance, and customer outcomes, and leverage data-driven insights to guide roadmap decisions.

· Partner with GTM teams to develop product positioning, pricing, competitive differentiation, enablement, and successful product launches that accelerate customer adoption and revenue growth.

· Represent the voice of enterprise customers by engaging with CISOs, SOC analysts, security architects, partners, and analysts to validate product direction and identify emerging opportunities.

· Drive cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, security research, executive leadership, and business stakeholders while influencing strategic decisions across the enterprise security portfolio.

· Mentor product managers, foster a culture of customer-centric innovation and execution excellence, and provide thought leadership on enterprise cybersecurity, EDR/XDR, and AI Security trends.

Must-Have Qualifications

· 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5+ years leading Enterprise Cybersecurity products such as EDR, XDR, Endpoint Protection, SIEM, SOAR, Identity Security, Cloud Security, or AI Security.

· Proven experience defining product strategy, owning end-to-end roadmaps, and delivering enterprise security products from concept through commercialization.

· Strong understanding of endpoint security, detection and response, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident response workflows, and modern SOC operations.

· Demonstrated knowledge of AI Security concepts, including LLM security, AI-powered detection and response, security copilots, agentic AI, prompt injection risks, and responsible AI practices.

· Strong technical aptitude with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, security research, AI/ML, and architecture teams, translating complex technical concepts into customer-centric product capabilities.

· Excellent customer engagement skills, with experience working directly with CISOs, SOC analysts, security architects, enterprise customers, partners, and industry analysts to validate product strategy and roadmap.

· Strong analytical and business acumen with experience defining product success metrics, analysing customer adoption and usage data, and driving data-informed product decisions.

· Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams across product, engineering, threat research, sales, marketing, customer success, and support in a fast-paced environment.

· Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and product execution skills, with a track record of delivering differentiated enterprise products that drive customer value and business growth.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

· Experience building AI-native cybersecurity products, including Security Copilots, AI-assisted threat hunting, autonomous investigations, or agentic security workflows.

· Working knowledge of cloud security technologies, including AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Containers, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, or Identity Security.

· Familiarity with detection engineering concepts, including Sigma, YARA, behavioral analytics, telemetry pipelines, and detection rule development.

· Experience with Zero Trust architectures, MDR/XDR platforms, vulnerability management, or data security solutions.

· Exposure to regulatory and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, DORA, GDPR, or the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

· MBA or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

Why Join Us

· Lead the strategy and roadmap for next-generation Enterprise Cybersecurity products spanning EDR, XDR, and AI Security at one of India's leading cybersecurity companies.

· Build innovative security solutions that help enterprises detect, investigate, and respond to evolving cyber threats across endpoint, identity, cloud, and AI environments.

· Drive high-impact product initiatives with direct influence on technology strategy, customer success, market differentiation, and business growth.

· Collaborate with world-class engineering, threat research, AI/ML, and security experts in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment committed to shaping the future of enterprise cybersecurity.

Quick Heal Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobDescription:

Our product stack spans Endpoint Protection, XDR, Zero Trust, Threat Intelligence, Data Privacy, and beyond - built upon a robust Cybersecurity Mesh Architecture.

Quick Heal Academy (QHA) is a leading institute for cybersecurity education and training. We collaborate with universities and organizations to build skilled professionals and strengthen the global cybersecurity ecosystem.

Quick Heal drives impactful CSR initiatives through its foundation, focusing on education, employability, vocational training, and cybersecurity awareness—contributing to a safer, inclusive, and sustainable future.

Position: Senior Software Engineer

Experience: 4+ Yrs

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Security Engineering team, working on the core engine of our Data Loss Prevention (DLP) product. You will take independent ownership of complex engineering problems, designing and building high-performance, production-grade components for Windows-based endpoint security software.

This role demands deep technical expertise in C/C++, strong fundamentals in data structures and algorithms, and the ability to navigate Windows internals and concurrent systems confidently — with minimal supervision.

Job Description:

  • Design and develop robust, high-performance C/C++ modules for the DLP endpoint agent on Windows.

  • Architect and implement multithreaded subsystems — ensuring thread safety, low latency, and correctness under concurrent workloads.

  • Apply strong DSA knowledge to solve performance-critical problems: efficient data processing, memory management, and algorithmic optimization.

  • Work with Windows internals to build components that interact with OS-level constructs — processes, handles, memory, I/O, and the Windows security model.

  • Independently debug and resolve complex issues including crashes, memory corruption, race conditions, and performance regressions.

  • Analyse crash dumps and live system failures using Win Dbg to identify root causes and deliver timely fixes.

  • Own features end-to-end — from design document through implementation, testing, and production deployment.

  • Conduct thorough code reviews and contribute to raising the overall code quality bar within the team.

  • Collaborate with product managers, QA, and security researchers to shape and deliver impactful features.

Required Skills:

  • 4–8 years of professional software development experience with strong C/C++ programming skills.

  • Solid multithreading expertise — thread synchronization, mutexes, condition variables, lock-free patterns, deadlock analysis, and concurrent data structures.

  • Sound understanding of Windows internals — process and thread model, virtual memory, handle management, IPC mechanisms, and the Windows security architecture.

  • Strong foundations in Data Structures & Algorithms — proficient in applying the right data structure or algorithm to real-world engineering problems.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, drive technical decisions, and deliver with minimal supervision.

  • Excellent debugging skills with proven ability to troubleshoot complex system-level issues.

Desired Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with crash dump analysis using Win Dbg — live debugging, kernel/user-mode dump triage, call stack analysis, and memory inspection.

  • Familiarity with advanced Win Dbg commands, extensions (SOS, MEX, SOSEX), and scripting for automated dump analysis.

  • Ability to independently scope, design, and deliver complex features with little to no day-to-day guidance.

  • Experience with Windows kernel-mode development — WDM, KMDF, or mini-filter drivers.

  • Exposure to endpoint security products such as DLP, EDR, AV, or HIPS.

  • Familiarity with performance profiling tools — Windows Performance Analyzer, VTune, or Perf View.
